description:
report/decision-report.yaml — the seven design components (§5/S8).

Components 2, 3, and 7 pair an agent narration field with code-rendered
tables: the matrix, both scoreboards, the sensitivity tables, and the
appendix tables are computed and embedded by code at render time.

winner_option_id.description: Must be rank 1 on the preference-adjusted scoreboard — code cross-checks it.
winner_option_id.title: Winner Option Id

recommendation.description: §5/S8-1: the recommendation with its decisive reasons, every factual sentence annotated [[claim-id]] (or [[option-id:claim-id]] when the bare id is ambiguous across dossiers).
recommendation.title: Recommendation

decision_matrix_narration.description: §5/S8-2: what the finalists x criteria matrix (code-rendered beside this narration) says — where the winner is strong, weak, uncertain.
decision_matrix_narration.title: Decision Matrix Narration

sensitivity_narration.description: §5/S8-3: narrates the CODE-computed flip deltas and the preference-slot sweep. If the winner is fragile to plausible weight changes, this must say so prominently.
sensitivity_narration.title: Sensitivity Narration

dissent.description: §5/S8-4: the prosecution's best surviving argument against the winner, stated at full strength.
dissent.title: Dissent

dissent_unrebutted.description: True when nothing in the tournament rebutted the dissent — the report must then say so explicitly.
dissent_unrebutted.title: Dissent Unrebutted

dissent_source.description: Workspace-relative path of the prosecution the dissent survives from.
dissent_source.title: Dissent Source

residual_uncertainty.description: §5/S8-5: open questions, BUDGET-CAPPED areas, and what new information should trigger revisiting the decision.
residual_uncertainty.title: Residual Uncertainty

next_actions.description: §5/S8-6: concrete next steps, folding in any execution-kind strategic notes that apply to the winner.
next_actions.title: Next Actions

appendix_notes.description: §5/S8-7 commentary; the appendix tables themselves (angle map, allocation, cut audit, pass rates, spend) are code-rendered.
appendix_notes.title: Appendix Notes

title: DecisionReport
